name: OCI ZPR Visibility
description: Dashboard query catalog for OCI ZPR posture, policy inventory, protected resources, allow/block traffic, and governance findings.

widgets.name: Active ZPR policies
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | stats dc(policy_id) as active_policies by policy_lifecycle_state

widgets.name: Protected resources
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | stats dc(resource_id) as protected_resources by resource_type

widgets.name: Top findings
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' | stats count as findings by severity, finding_type | sort -findings

widgets.name: Policy statement table
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | fields policy_name, policy_lifecycle_state, source_attribute, destination_attribute, network_scope, target_type, statement

widgets.name: Source destination matrix
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | stats count as rules by source_attribute, destination_attribute, network_scope

widgets.name: Broad CIDR exceptions
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' and finding_type = 'broad_cidr_exception' | fields severity, policy_name, cidr, recommendation

widgets.name: Resources by attribute
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | stats count as resources by security_attributes

widgets.name: Resources by subnet
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | stats count as resources by subnet_id, resource_type

widgets.name: Resource detail
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | fields resource_name, resource_type, private_ip, subnet_id, security_attributes

widgets.name: Enriched ACCEPT vs REJECT
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' | stats count as flows by action, classification

widgets.name: Rejected protected destinations
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and action = 'REJECT' and zpr_destination = true | stats count as rejects by destination_resource_name, destination_ip, destination_port, protocol | sort -rejects

widgets.name: Unexpected accepted flows
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and classification = 'unexpected_accepted' | fields source_resource_name, destination_resource_name, destination_ip, destination_port, protocol

widgets.name: Policy drift candidates
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | stats latest(statement_hash) as latest_hash, earliest(statement_hash) as first_hash by policy_id, statement | where latest_hash != first_hash

widgets.name: Missing policy findings
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' and finding_type = 'protected_resource_no_matching_policy' | fields severity, resource_name, resource_type, security_attributes, recommendation
